Name: Simple Vibrant Artisan Goods
Description:
[center][url=https://ko-fi.com/6480k]~ I have a Kofi ~[/url][/center]

[b]Simple Vibrant Artisan Goods[/b] is a barebones content pack for [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/40490]DISCO[/url][/b] (Dynamic Item Sprite Compositor) that makes vanilla colored artisan goods (Wine, Pickles, etc) more visually vibrant by replacing the vanilla color overlay system with custom recolored sprites.

If you've used BAGI or EBAGI content packs before, this is a lot like that, except that[b] it automatically works for every modded crop[/b]. Rather than a custom sprite for every produce item, Simple Vibrant Artisan Goods has a custom sprite for [b]every possible color[/b], which means that you don't need to worry about adding compatibility for modded input items.

Features:
- Vibrant, vanilla-friendly icons for Wine, Juice, Pickles, Jelly
- Optional mini produce icon to help you distinguish different artisan good flavors from each other
- Additional custom sprites for some (but not all) artisan goods flavors. For example, Apple will make yellow colored artisan goods and Melon will make green colored artisan goods (trust me, it makes sense).
- Optional Honey color variation
- Prismatic-colored items now have prismatic-colored artisan goods.

This mod can be easily configured in the DISCO config menu (using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]).

[b]Q: Does this mod work with retextures?[/b]
A: You CAN use this mod with retextures, but the items will still be vanilla art. Anyone is welcome to copy the code and assets in this mod if they wish to remake it for a specific retexture mod.

I highly recommend using this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38080]Sensible Item Colors[/url]. Sensible Item Colors tweaks the color data of some items, and in this case it will make your vegetable artisan goods prettier, because instead of everything being 'green' like they are in vanilla, some items will be 'dark green', 'light green', 'sea green', and so on. So vegetable Juices and Pickles will have more variety in terms of color.

I also have the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22908]I Hate Flower Colors[/url] to do something similar for vanilla flowers, and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38755]Produce Category Swapper[/url] lets you tweak some produce item categories such as changing a Tomato from a Vegetable to a Fruit.
